data.body: Started the master coverage inventory. The repository has 3,222 tracked files. Relevant groups include 10 root documents, 65 top-level docs pages, 103 ADR files, 164 experiment assets, 14 infrastructure documents, 18 example or template documents, 55 CLI help files, 3 packaged guides, 87 reviewer prompts, 40 evaluation or workflow text assets, 555 source Python files, 66 script files, 1,511 test Python files, 91 workflow or configuration files, and 156 machine-corpus assets. A candidate scan across 427 Markdown, RST, or help text files found 7,973 em dash matches across 361 files, 219 en dash matches across 83 files, 216 spaced-hyphen matches across 54 files, 5,121 semicolon matches across 387 files, 1,886 filler-term matches across 292 files, and hard-wrap candidates across 362 Markdown files. These counts include code examples, quotations, technical tokens, and permitted contexts. They are triage signals rather than confirmed defects. Three exploration agents are inspecting the defined shards. No project files changed.
